scope.goal: Eliminate starvation of expired exact ETH Reference Average Maker-GTD Paper orders at the market-data receipt/expiry admission fence while preserving every existing fill-evidence, outstanding-update, continuity, atomic-persistence, and Paper-only rule.
inScope: Replace the current opportunistic expiry admission, which returns null whenever any market-data receipt is active, with a starvation-free asynchronous admission: receipts already active when expiry requests admission finish first, receipts arriving later cannot overtake that expiry request, and expiry obtains an exclusive lease before evaluating the order.
Make PaperTradingProcessor await the starvation-free expiry admission instead of silently deferring an expired Maker-GTD order to another five-second cycle solely because a receipt is active.

Preserve concurrent processing of market-data receipts when no expiry admission is pending and preserve cancellation without leaking an admission lease or permanently blocking later receipts/expiries.

Keep the existing per-order outstanding pre-expiry side-effect update check: an actually queued or in-flight eligible update still defers that order until the update completes; this task adds no timeout, grace period, event drop, or guessed terminal result.

Add deterministic concurrency and lifecycle regressions that reproduce continuous-receipt starvation and prove a queued expiry request completes before later receipts while the existing Maker-GTD evidence and atomic expiry paths remain unchanged.
Document the starvation-free admission ordering and its explicit limitation for a genuinely hung receipt or outstanding side-effect update.
Build, run focused tests, mechanically validate, independently review, commit, and push the correction to codex/reference-average-available-windows.
outOfScope: Changing Reference Average signals, thresholds, windows, outcomes, order price, stake, entry timing, GTD/PostOnly intent, TouchNoDepth fill inference, mandatory label, fee/PnL/settlement accounting, or Live behavior.

Adding an arbitrary expiry timeout, dropping or ignoring an eligible pre-expiry market-data update, treating an unprocessed frame as a fill or no-fill, or changing market-data continuity classifications.

Changing PaperPositionMarkWorker, position-mark calculations, worker cadence/configuration, database schema, repository queries, WebSocket subscriptions, queue capacity, or copied-performance processing.
Directly expiring, replaying, filling, rewriting, or otherwise mutating the currently observed production backlog; restarting, deploying, or reconfiguring production.
Claiming that this admission-fairness correction resolves a genuinely hung receipt or permanently hung side-effect update; those require separate evidence and approval if observed after deployment.
scope.periodOrFilter: Exact closed-exception ETH neutral Reference Average Maker-GTD Paper lifecycle plus the shared admission primitive. Production preview at 2026-08-20T09:08:31.233102Z found 15 Pending/Resting orders overdue across effective expiries 08:49Z, 08:54Z, 08:59Z, and 09:04Z; ordinary BTC/ETH/SOL Paper entries and position marks remained active.
scope.firstVerification: Trace the exact deployed 6ceddfca call path from MarketDataWebSocketShardRunner receipt admission through MakerGtdPaperPlacementHandoff.TryEnterExpiryAdmissionAsync and PaperTradingProcessor.TryExpireMakerGtdPaperOrderAsync, then reproduce the no-fairness behavior deterministically in a focused test without production mutation.

requirements.text: An expiry admission request must not be starved by a continuing stream of later market-data receipts.
acceptanceCriteria: If one or more receipt leases are already active, an expiry admission request remains asynchronously pending until those exact active receipts finish; it does not return a normal null/deferred result.
After an expiry request is pending, every receipt request that arrives later remains pending until the expiry lease is released; later receipts cannot overtake the queued expiry.
When no expiry request is pending, multiple receipt leases may remain concurrently active exactly as before.
Cancellation while expiry waits releases its queue position and leaves the handoff usable by subsequent receipt and expiry admissions.
The no-op handoff preserves its nonblocking test/default behavior under the non-null expiry-admission contract.

verification.expected: Deterministic tests prove active receipts drain before expiry, later receipts cannot overtake, receipt concurrency remains, cancellation recovers, and no sleep/timing guess is required.

requirements.text: Paper Maker-GTD expiry must await fair admission while preserving all existing evidence and financial semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: PaperTradingProcessor awaits a non-null expiry admission for each expired Maker-GTD evaluation and no longer records the ordinary active-receipt deferral branch.

Once admitted, the existing order-evidence parser, queued/in-flight eligible pre-expiry update check, market-data failure lookup, exact linked-run requirement, continuity evaluation, skip reason/diagnostics, and atomic order/run mutation execute unchanged.
An actually outstanding eligible pre-expiry side-effect update still defers only the affected order; no timeout, event drop, fabricated no-fill, or post-expiry touch is introduced.

A deterministic lifecycle test holds an earlier receipt, starts expiry processing, then starts later receipts; after the earlier receipt is released, the expired exact-family order reaches the existing terminal path before the later receipts are admitted.

Existing Maker placement, authoritative TouchNoDepth fill, PostgreSQL timestamp-precision, evidence-unavailable expiry, atomic repository, worker-isolation, and Paper/live exception tests remain passing.

Documentation states both the new fair ordering and the unchanged limitation that a genuinely non-completing active receipt or outstanding side-effect update remains fail-closed rather than being discarded.
